name: Step 1 demographics and lifestyle field validation
description: Verifies step 1 accepts valid demographic fields (ageGroup, gender, activityLevel, sleepStress) and validates enum constraints.

name: Step 2 symptom multi-select chip selection
description: Verifies step 2 handles multi-select symptom array including fatigue, thirst_urination, and joint_pain.

name: Step 3 family history multi-select capture
description: Verifies step 3 accurately records family history tags (diabetes, hypertension, kidney).

name: Quiz step navigation forward and backward state persistence
description: Verifies state persists across step transitions (Step 1 -> Step 2 -> Step 3) without data loss.

name: Single symptom general_checkup selection behavior
description: Verifies selecting 'general_checkup' represents routine wellness without penalizing baseline vitality.

name: Invalid symptom rejection guard
description: Verifies validation failure when non-contract symptom string is provided.

name: Vitality score computation for pristine young adult
description: Verifies maximum bounded Vitality Score (98) for optimal baseline demographics and zero symptoms.

name: Metabolic risk axis elevation on thirst and diabetes history
description: Verifies metabolic axis is flagged 'High' with >= 60% risk score when thirst_urination and diabetes history are present.

name: Cardiovascular risk axis elevation on BP concerns and hypertension history
description: Verifies cardiovascular axis reaches 'High' risk with arterial tension markers when BP concerns and family hypertension exist.

name: Renal risk axis elevation on kidney family history and comorbid symptoms
description: Verifies renal risk evaluates to 'High' when family kidney history is coupled with systemic strain.

name: Joint and inflammation axis elevation on stiffness and senior age
description: Verifies joint/inflammation axis evaluates to 'High' when joint stiffness is accompanied by advanced age or sedentary strain.

name: Vitality bracket classification transitions
description: Verifies bracket thresholds: Optimal (>=80), Moderate (55-79), Elevated Risk (<55).

name: Joint package matched for musculoskeletal symptoms
description: Verifies primary package is 'joint' or 'specialjoint' paired with smartadvance.

name: Clinical explanation includes HbA1c for metabolic indications

name: Clinical explanation includes CBC for fatigue symptoms

name: Clinical explanation includes KFT for renal and filtration indications

name: Cart addition updates item quantity by 1

name: Repeated clicks on Add to Cart increments count smoothly

name: Spring settle duration within 600ms tolerance band

name: Reduced motion bypass disables animated spring delay
description: Verifies prefers-reduced-motion returns instant target value with zero animation delay.

name: Spring velocity decay monotonicity after peak
